# Teasing Media

> A small studio in Brighton, East Sussex, England that cuts teaser trailers for product, book, game and app launches from the client's own footage, artwork and screen captures.

- Packages: 15-second teaser £450; 30-second teaser £850; 60-second launch trailer £1,600; extra frame size £90 each; extra revision round £120.
- Every teaser exports in 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 with two revision rounds included.
- Does not film events or weddings, buy advertising, promise views or sales, or use celebrity voices.
- Contact: studio@teasing-media.com
